```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(targets)

cells <- tar_read(development_cells)
stage1 <- tar_read(stage1_all)
stage2 <- tar_read(stage2_development)
onestage <- tar_read(onestage_check)
manifest <- tar_read(data_manifest)
settings <- tar_read(settings)
registry <- tar_read(outcome_registry)

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
num <- function(x, digits = 3) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10))
labels <- registry$rows[c("variable_name", "node")]
```

This report exists to check that the engine works, not to report findings.
The cells here are the **development cells**: the only associations fitted before the specification is frozen, listed in `analysis/development_cells.csv` and in the deviations ledger.
Their results are exploratory, go in no report to the funder as they stand, and are marked as seen before the freeze wherever they later appear.
Data: `r nrow(manifest)` datasets, overall hash `r unique(manifest$overall_hash)`.

## What was fitted

`r nrow(cells)` cells: `r paste(unique(cells$exposure), collapse = ", ")` against `r n_distinct(cells$outcome)` outcome rows.
`r n_distinct(stage1$outcome)` of those outcome rows are measured alongside the exposure in at least one dataset.

```{r}
#| label: stage1-status
stage1 |>
  mutate(status = ifelse(grepl("^model failed", status), "model failed", status)) |>
  summarise(units = n(), datasets = n_distinct(dataset_id), rows = sum(n), .by = status) |>
  arrange(desc(units)) |>
  transmute(`Stage 1 outcome` = status, `Unit-by-cell fits` = fmt(units), Datasets = datasets, Rows = fmt(rows)) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrrr")
```

```{r}
#| label: stage1-how
fitted <- filter(stage1, status == "fitted")
fitted |>
  count(effect_measure, engine, se_type, weighted) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  transmute(`Effect measure` = effect_measure, Engine = engine, `Standard errors` = se_type, Weighted = ifelse(weighted, "yes", "no"), Fits = fmt(n)) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "llllr", caption = "How the fitted units were modelled.")
```

```{r}
#| label: stage1-rows
fitted |>
  summarise(
    units = n(),
    available = sum(n_available),
    used = sum(n),
    no_weight = sum(n_no_weight),
    no_sex = sum(n_no_sex),
    lost_5 = sum(n < 0.95 * n_available),
    few_clusters = sum(few_clusters %in% TRUE)
  ) |>
  transmute(
    `Fitted unit-by-cell models` = fmt(units),
    `Rows with exposure and outcome` = fmt(available),
    `Rows used` = fmt(used),
    `Left out: no weight in a weighted unit` = fmt(no_weight),
    `Left out: sex unknown or other` = fmt(no_sex),
    `Fits that use under 95% of their rows` = fmt(lost_5),
    `Fits with fewer than 10 clusters` = fmt(few_clusters)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = " ", values_to = "Count") |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lr", caption = "Rows a model could have used against rows it did.")
```

```{r}
#| label: stage1-lost
fitted |>
  mutate(share_used = n / n_available) |>
  filter(share_used < 0.95) |>
  summarise(fits = n(), lowest = min(share_used), no_weight = sum(n_no_weight), no_sex = sum(n_no_sex), .by = dataset_id) |>
  arrange(lowest) |>
  transmute(Dataset = dataset_id, `Fits affected` = fits, `Lowest share of rows used` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * lowest), `Rows without a weight` = fmt(no_weight), `Rows with sex unknown` = fmt(no_sex)) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrrrr", caption = "Datasets where a fitted model uses under 95% of the rows that have the exposure and the outcome.")
```

```{r}
#| label: stage1-covariates
fitted |>
  count(covariates) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  transmute(`Covariates in the unit's model` = covariates, Fits = fmt(n)) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lr")
```

## Stage 1 slopes

```{r}
#| label: fig-slopes
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-cap: "Unit slopes in SD per hour against their standard errors, for every outcome together. Outcomes differ in direction, so no single funnel is expected; the plot is here to show units far from the rest."
fitted |>
  filter(effect_measure == "sd_per_hour") |>
  ggplot(aes(estimate, se)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Slope, SD per hour a day", y = "Standard error")
```

```{r}
#| label: extreme
fitted |>
  filter(effect_measure == "sd_per_hour") |>
  mutate(z = estimate / se) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) |>
  head(15) |>
  transmute(Dataset = dataset_id, Wave = coalesce(wave, ""), Country = coalesce(country, ""), Outcome = outcome, Slope = num(estimate), SE = num(se), N = fmt(n)) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "llllrrr", caption = "The 15 largest unit slopes, as a check for implausible values.")
```

## Stage 2

A cell is pooled from `r settings$min_datasets` or more datasets.
Where the robust estimate has fewer than 4 degrees of freedom the cell reads "too few studies to say".
An SD shown as 0.000 is an estimate at its boundary, usually where one dataset carries most of the weight, and not a finding that slopes do not vary.
Units of one dataset are treated as independent; where a panel's waves share children, some of that shared error is counted as variation between datasets.

```{r}
#| label: stage2-status
stage2 |>
  count(status) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Stage 2 outcome", "Cells"))
```

```{r}
#| label: stage2-table
stage2 |>
  filter(status != "insufficient data") |>
  left_join(labels, by = c("outcome" = "variable_name")) |>
  arrange(node, desc(k_datasets)) |>
  transmute(
    Node = node,
    Outcome = outcome,
    Measure = effect_measure,
    Datasets = k_datasets,
    Units = k_units,
    Estimate = num(estimate),
    `95% interval` = paste0(num(ci_low), " to ", num(ci_high)),
    df = num(df, 1),
    `SD between datasets` = num(tau_dataset),
    `SD between units` = num(tau_unit),
    `Prediction interval` = paste0(num(pi_low), " to ", num(pi_high)),
    Status = status
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lllrrrlrrrll")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-robust-vs-model
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-cap: "Width of the robust interval against the model-based one, by number of datasets. The two should converge as datasets increase."
stage2 |>
  filter(status != "insufficient data") |>
  mutate(ratio = (ci_high - ci_low) / (model_ci_high - model_ci_low)) |>
  ggplot(aes(k_datasets, ratio)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Datasets in the cell", y = "Robust interval width / model-based width")
```

## Forest plot for the one-stage cell

```{r}
#| label: fig-forest
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: "Unit slopes for the one-stage check's cell, grouped by dataset, with the pooled estimate and its interval. Dataset IDs only."
cell <- tar_read(onestage_cell)
forest <- fitted |>
  filter(exposure == cell[["exposure"]], outcome == cell[["outcome"]]) |>
  arrange(as.numeric(dataset_id), wave, country) |>
  mutate(row = row_number())
pooled <- filter(stage2, exposure == cell[["exposure"]], outcome == cell[["outcome"]])
ggplot(forest, aes(y = reorder(unit, -row))) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = pooled$ci_low, xmax = pooled$ci_high, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = pooled$estimate, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = estimate - qt(0.975, df) * se, xmax = estimate + qt(0.975, df) * se), colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(x = estimate, size = 1 / se^2), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Slope, SD per hour a day", y = "Unit (dataset | wave | country)") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))
```

## One-stage check

The one-stage model has an intercept per unit, the exposure centred within unit, a residual variance per unit and each unit's own age and sex effects, and lets the slope vary between datasets and between a dataset's units, as stage 2 does.
It is unweighted, so it is compared with a two-stage estimate built the same way: unweighted per-unit models with linear age and sex, pooled with the same two levels of variation.
The one-stage standard error is model-based and the two-stage one is robust, so they are not expected to match exactly.

```{r}
#| label: onestage
tibble::tibble(
  ` ` = c(
    "Cell",
    "Status",
    "Datasets, units, rows",
    "One-stage slope (SE)",
    "Matched two-stage slope (SE)",
    "SD between datasets: one-stage, two-stage",
    "SD between units: one-stage, two-stage",
    "Gap on the contrast of 1 against 4 hours",
    "Trigger",
    "Primary (weighted) two-stage slope, for reference"
  ),
  Value = c(
    paste(cell[["exposure"]], "by", cell[["outcome"]]),
    onestage$status,
    paste(onestage$k_datasets, fmt(onestage$k_units), fmt(onestage$n), sep = ", "),
    paste0(num(onestage$onestage_estimate, 4), " (", num(onestage$onestage_se, 4), ")"),
    paste0(num(onestage$twostage_estimate, 4), " (", num(onestage$twostage_se, 4), ")"),
    paste(num(onestage$onestage_tau), num(onestage$twostage_tau), sep = ", "),
    paste(num(onestage$onestage_tau_unit), num(onestage$twostage_tau_unit), sep = ", "),
    num(onestage$contrast_gap, 4),
    paste0(num(onestage$trigger, 2), ifelse(isTRUE(onestage$exceeds_trigger), ": exceeded", ": not exceeded")),
    if (nrow(pooled) == 1) paste0(num(pooled$estimate, 4), " (", num(pooled$se, 4), ")") else "not pooled"
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
